fixed_review_findings: Initial Condition entry is timed and released in finally.
Free nonzero and queued handoff paths check monotonic deadline before granting ownership.
NaN/>TIMEOUT_MAX rejected before owner fast path; original timeout error types preserved. Other public negative values remain rejected by unchanged FileLock constructor.

Same-owner reentrancy now precedes Condition entry, including timeout0 while a contender temporarily holds bookkeeping mutex. Only owner modifies depth while held; contenders inspect ownership under condition.
ownership_fifo_exception_assessment: FIFO applies to enrollment order among waiting threads. Reentrant owner intentionally remains able to nest; outsiders cannot bypass existing queued tokens.
Wait tokens remain until acquired/expired/interrupted and are removed with notify_all in finally; each live waiter keeps the deque nonempty while it tests its head.
Gate release checks owner before decrementing gate depth; final owner release wakes queued contenders.
All original FileLock/OS advisory locking, handle cleanup, initial lock-file byte/fsync, file retention, registry keying and timeout/polling operations remain AST-identical.

Condition.wait standard reacquisition of bookkeeping can delay cleanup until scheduling permits; this is not a hard real-time guarantee. No protected filesystem I/O occurs under Condition bookkeeping mutex.
inherited_or_bounded_limitations: Wrong-thread FileLock.release changes state before underlying gate validates ownership, as in original RLock-backed class. This unsupported-use behavior is unchanged and not claimed repaired.
Thread identity reuse after an owner thread exits without releasing remains an inherited RLock-like boundary.
FIFO applies only in-process; OS lock scheduling across processes remains unchanged.

Long legitimate critical sections, nested owner work, scheduling stalls or OS blocking can still produce 10-second timeouts. The observed 85PASS/1FAIL event-concurrency capture does not prove barging or OS cause.
memory_cost_assessment: Persistent per-path registry retention remains unchanged; no cache/weak-reference/identity redesign introduced.
Each state now adds a Condition/RLock and deque; each active waiter adds a token plus Condition waiting state. Outer tokens are removed on normal handoff, timeout or wait exception.
notify_all and deque.remove cause contention/scheduling and linear queue-removal cost; fairness may trade throughput for bounded enrollment order. No measured benefit asserted.
Unchanged _state_for eager setdefault allocates a discarded state on existing keys, now with more bookkeeping objects; no expansion of scope is recommended solely from this observation.
